_about: Hand-checked against PacificBiosciences/trgt at b21c6217eeaef9a080205932fe29f730dc00e31f (tag v5.1.0) on 2026-09-29, from README.md, docs/tutorial.md, docs/cli.md, docs/repeat_files.md, docs/puretarget.md, CHANGELOG.md, Cargo.toml, example/, the v5.1.0 GitHub release and api.anaconda.org.

install.documented: Download the Linux binary from the GitHub releases page and run it from PATH or by relative path; no source build, conda package or container is documented.

input.revised: 2026-09-29: STRhub now holds PacBio HiFi reads: pacbio-hifi-bam-hg38, a CODIS ±10 kb slice of GIAB's HG002 Revio HiFi BAM (pacbio_slices/HG002.hifi.codis.bam), with a TRGT repeat-definition file of its 20 panel loci (datasets/pacbio-hifi-bam-hg38/regions/trgt.bed, ID/MOTIFS/STRUC layout).

extra_inputs.what: Repeat definition BED in TRGT layout: chrom, start, end and a fourth column 'ID=<unique id>;MOTIFS=<motif[,motif...]>;STRUC=<TR>'. The README points to STRchive, the Adotto catalog and the Broad tandem-repeat-catalog; repeats/pathogenic_repeats.hg38.bed in the repo is deprecated.
extra_inputs.revised: 2026-09-29: STRhub now holds PacBio HiFi reads: pacbio-hifi-bam-hg38, a CODIS ±10 kb slice of GIAB's HG002 Revio HiFi BAM (pacbio_slices/HG002.hifi.codis.bam), with a TRGT repeat-definition file of its 20 panel loci (datasets/pacbio-hifi-bam-hg38/regions/trgt.bed, ID/MOTIFS/STRUC layout).

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: 2026-09-29: STRhub now holds PacBio HiFi reads: pacbio-hifi-bam-hg38, a CODIS ±10 kb slice of GIAB's HG002 Revio HiFi BAM (pacbio_slices/HG002.hifi.codis.bam), with a TRGT repeat-definition file of its 20 panel loci (datasets/pacbio-hifi-bam-hg38/regions/trgt.bed, ID/MOTIFS/STRUC layout). The documented command (docs/tutorial.md:39-42) then has everything it needs: --genome hg38, --repeats the library file, --reads the HiFi BAM. Run locally on 2026-09-29 with the released v5.1.0 binary, it wrote sample.vcf.gz with all 20 loci genotyped.

was.why: TRGT genotypes aligned PacBio HiFi reads ('BAM file with aligned HiFi reads', docs/cli.md:36); STRhub holds no HiFi dataset (its only long-read set is ONT R10). It also needs a repeat definition BED in TRGT's ID/MOTIFS/STRUC layout, which is not one of STRhub's region layouts.

notes: Bioconda holds trgt 5.1.0 but no document mentions it. Cargo.toml and build.rs are present but no source build is documented, so cargo is not a faithful reading. docs/puretarget.md:64-70 documents a second genotype form for PacBio PureTarget data (--preset targeted, --fail-reads ...), still HiFi. Genotyping writes unsorted <prefix>.vcf.gz and <prefix>.spanning.bam (docs/cli.md:39); the tutorial lists samtools and bcftools as separate prerequisites to sort and index them (docs/tutorial.md:10,73-90). Default karyotype is XX (docs/cli.md:40). The tutorial prints the example repeat as starting at 10000 (docs/tutorial.md:28) while example/repeat.bed holds 10001. The README itself has no command; it links the tutorial and CLI reference (README.md:47-63).
